items.t: Ignition coil inside the distributor fails
items.note: RepairPal lists about $216-$348 total for 1996-1998. Replacing the whole distributor costs more.

items.t: Starter fails and the engine won't crank
Failed emissions test from a clogged EGR system
items.note: RepairPal lists about $445-$490 total for 1995-1998. Cleaning clogged passages alone may cost less.

items.t: Rattle from the timing belt tensioner
items.note: RepairPal lists about $631-$890 for the belt on 1996-1998; a timing belt idler pulley alone runs about $329-$528.

items.t: Check engine light from a failing rear oxygen sensor
Crankshaft sensor code (P0335) from a weak battery
items.note: RepairPal lists a battery test at about $49-$72. A new battery, if needed, costs extra.

items.t: Rough idle and backfiring with the check engine light on
items.job: Diagnose misfire and replace spark plugs
items.note: RepairPal lists spark plugs at about $73-$106. A distributor coil or idle air control valve costs more if needed.

items.job: Fuel pressure test and no-start diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal lists a fuel pressure test at about $61-$90. Parts depend on what the test finds.

items.t: Check engine light at high altitude (P0130/P0133)
items.note: RepairPal lists an oxygen sensor test at about $49-$72.

items.job: Battery, charging and parasitic draw test
items.note: A basic battery test is about $49-$72 at RepairPal; tracking down a hidden draw can take an hour or more.
RepairPal lists about $213-$241 for 1995-1998. This fixes missing fan speeds; weak heat with a working fan has other causes.
